definitions: A small, decorative loop or series of loops, often made with thread or yarn, used as an edging or embellishment on fabric, lace, or ribbon.
A small, pointed projection or indentation, especially one forming part of a decorative edge.
examples: The wedding veil was edged with delicate picots.
She added a picot to the hem of the baby blanket.
The lace had a beautiful picot design.
